title: Modules
intro: Optional areas of {{brand}}. Switch off what your team does not use: its pages, menu entries, routes and background jobs go away for everyone. Its data stays, and comes back when you switch the area on again.
switchedOff: {{name}} is switched off. Its data is kept.

off.title: This area is switched off
off.text: An administrator can turn it on in Settings → Modules.
off.textAdmin: You can turn it on in Settings → Modules. Its data was kept.

ownSettings: Switched on and set up below.
mapSettings: On while the plant registry is on and a map source is chosen (below, under Map).
defaultOff: Off until an administrator turns it on.
docs: Maturity of every area and connector

compliance.name: Compliance and evidence
compliance.description: Control catalogues, access changes, access reconciliation, person reviews and evidence packs.

statusPages.name: Status pages
statusPages.description: Read-only pages for colleagues outside the team, and the status viewer role.

scorecard.name: Scorecard
scorecard.description: Availability objectives and the scorecard of services (a view of Services).

costs.name: Costs
costs.description: Platform costs in one cost model (FOCUS showback), budgets and the cost readers (a view of Services).

dataContracts.name: Data contracts
dataContracts.description: ODCS data contracts, their versions, breaking-change rules and tests.

ai.name: AI models
ai.description: LLM gateways, the “Ask an AI model” step, token budgets and the usage log.

teamsBot.name: Approvals in Microsoft Teams
teamsBot.description: The Teams bot that lets people decide approvals in a Teams card.

libraries.name: Shared procedure libraries
libraries.description: Signed library releases, trusted publishers and installed libraries.

versionWatch.name: Version watch and end of life
versionWatch.description: Newest versions and end-of-life dates of the tech stack of applications and systems.

changedetection.name: changedetection.io
changedetection.description: Page watches of changedetection.io platforms, their monitor check and reviews.

plant.name: Plant registry
plant.description: Sites, assets, device profiles, KPIs and the OT network of your plants.

plantMap.name: Map of sites
plantMap.description: The sites of the plant registry on a map, with tiles served through {{brand}}.

stable.name: stable
stable.text: Stable: used and tested broadly; changes are announced in the change log.

beta.name: beta
beta.text: Beta: complete, but little used so far. Expect rough edges.

preview.name: preview
preview.text: Preview: new; it may still change in ways that need you to act.

verified.real: Tested against real systems of this product.
verified.mock: Tested only against a simulation of the product in {{brand}}'s tests, not yet against a real system.
verified.none: Talks to no product of its own.

restricted.title: Nothing here you may see
restricted.text: There are entries you do not have access to. Ask an administrator or the team that owns them.
